APS operates as an engineering and procurement partner for process industries—primarily carbonated soft drinks (CSD), dairy, juice, sauces, brewing, pharmaceuticals, and industrial water treatment plants. APS resolves critical supply chain delays by providing certified OEM machinery, skid engineering, control systems, and verified genuine replacement parts.

## 2. Process Machinery & Engineered Systems

### 2.1 Carbonated Soft Drinks (CSD) Process Systems
URL: https://apsinox.com/systems/csd-syrup-rooms/
- **Batch Syrup Preparation Rooms**: Stainless steel 316L mixing tanks, high-shear agitators, automated sugar dissolving units, mass flow rate measurement, and CIP sanitization loops.
- **Continuous Carbonation Units**: Inline gas dosing, static carbonation manifolds, deaeration skids, and precision brix/CO2 analytical instrumentation.
- **Automated Routing Valve Manifolds**: Mix-proof valve matrices configured for simultaneous CIP cleaning and product transfer without cross-contamination.

### 2.2 Dairy Industry Solutions
- **HTST Pasteurizers**: High-Temperature Short-Time plate pasteurizers configured with regenerative heat recovery exceeding 90%, automated divert valves, and legal temperature recording.
- **High-Pressure Homogenizers**: Multi-stage sanitary homogenizing valves operating up to 300 bar for milk, cream, and fermented dairy products.
- **Centrifugal Separators**: Hermetic cream skimming separators, clarifiers, and bacteria removal centrifuges with automatic desludging.
- **Aseptic & Silo Storage Tanks**: Insulated, agitated 304/316L bulk milk silos and sterile buffer tanks with overpressure filtration.

### 2.3 Juice & Liquid Food Processing
- **Flash Pasteurization Systems**: Rapid thermal processing units designed to preserve flavor and vitamin profiles in fruit juices and pulps.
- **Aseptic Deaerators**: Vacuum deaeration vessels for oxygen removal prior to filling, preventing enzymatic oxidation.
- **Pulp & Concentrate Blending**: High-viscosity continuous blending systems with load cell gravimetric dosing.

### 2.4 Industrial Water Treatment Plants
URL: https://apsinox.com/systems/water-treatment/
- **Multi-Stage Media Filtration**: Automated sand filters, multimedia filters, and activated carbon beds for chlorine, odor, and turbidity reduction.
- **Reverse Osmosis (RO) Plants**: High-recovery spiral-wound membrane skids with anti-scalant dosing, CIP flush systems, and conductivity monitoring.
- **Ultraviolet (UV) Disinfection**: Stainless steel inline UV reactors ensuring microbial inactivation without chemical residue.

### 2.5 Clean-in-Place (CIP) Skids
URL: https://apsinox.com/systems/cip-skids/
- **Automated Multi-Tank Systems**: Configurations including caustic rinse, acid wash, fresh water, and recovery tanks.
- **Automated Chemical Dosing**: Inline conductivity control ensuring precise detergent concentrations and temperature management.
- **Hygienic Traceability**: Batch cycle logging compliant with 3-A Sanitary Standards and EHEDG guidelines.

### 2.6 Product Recovery & Pigging Systems
- **Sanitary Pigging Systems**: Dual-directional automated pigging lines using food-grade elastomer pigs to evacuate pipes before CIP.
- **Yield Optimization**: Reduces product loss in high-viscosity lines (syrup, dairy creams, tomato paste) by up to 98% and cuts wastewater effluents.

## 3. Genuine OEM Spare Parts & Replacement Channels

APS supplies 100% factory-original replacement parts cross-referenced against equipment serial numbers and engineering BOMs (Bill of Materials):

### 3.1 Sanitary Process Pumps
URL: https://apsinox.com/spares/pumps/
- **Centrifugal Pumps**: Impellers, mechanical shaft seals (SiC/SiC, Carbon/SiC, EPDM, FKM), casing O-rings, and motors.
- **Rotary Lobe Pumps**: Bi-wing and tri-lobe rotors, timing gears, mechanical seals, and wear plates.
- **Progressive Cavity & Twin Screw Pumps**: Sanitary stators, rotors, and universal joints for shear-sensitive fluids.
- **Supported Brands**: Alfa Laval (LKH, SolidC), Fristam, SPX Flow / APV, GEA Hilge, Waukesha Cherry-Burrell.

### 3.2 Process Valves & Actuation
URL: https://apsinox.com/spares/valves/
- **Mix-Proof Double-Seat Valves**: Radial seal sets, shaft seals, micro-switches, and pneumatic actuator overhaul kits.
- **Single-Seat & Regulating Valves**: Plugs, diaphragms, and proportional positioners (4-20mA / IO-Link).
- **Hygienic Butterfly Valves**: EPDM, Silicone, and FKM seal sleeves, manual levers, and pneumatic actuators.
- **Aseptic Diaphragm Valves**: PTFE/EPDM backed diaphragms, Saunders-type bonnets, and zero-deadleg T-valves.
- **Supported Brands**: Alfa Laval (Unique SSV, ThinkTop), GEA Tuchenhagen, SPX Flow / APV, Bardiani, Burkert, Pentair Südmo.

### 3.3 Heat Exchanger Spares
URL: https://apsinox.com/spares/heat-exchangers/
- **Plates**: Corrugated chevron plates in AISI 316L, AISI 304, Titanium, and Hastelloy.
- **Gaskets**: Clip-on and glued gaskets in EPDM, NBR, and Viton (FKM) rated for sanitary food grade and CIP temperatures up to 160°C.
- **Frame Hardware**: Zinc-coated and stainless steel tightening bolts, bearing boxes, and carrying bars.
- **Supported Brands**: Alfa Laval, GEA Kelvion, APV / SPX Flow, Tranter, Sondex / Danfoss.

### 3.4 Process Instrumentation & Transmitters
- **Pressure Transmitters**: Flush diaphragm hygienic pressure transmitters (4-20mA, HART).
- **Flow Meters**: Electromagnetic flowmeters with PFA/PTFE liners and Coriolis mass flowmeters.
- **Temperature & Level Sensors**: Pt100 RTD hygienic temperature sensors and hydrostatic/radar level transmitters.
- **Supported Brands**: Endress+Hauser, Siemens, IFM Efector, Anderson-Negele, WIKA.

### 3.5 Automation Hardware & Electrical Cabinets
- **Control Hardware**: Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLCs, I/O modules, communication processors (Profinet/Profibus), Schneider Electric, and Rockwell / Allen-Bradley.
- **Motor Control**: Variable frequency drives (VFDs) including Danfoss VLT, ABB, and Siemens Sinamics.
- **Panels**: Custom-built IP66 / NEMA 4X stainless steel enclosures with climate control and pneumatic solenoids.

## 4. Quality, Compliance & Provenance Guarantees

1. **100% Genuine Provenance**: No third-party counterfeit or unverified grey-market components. Sourced exclusively through manufacturer-authorized channels.
2. **0% Tolerance Deviation**: Exact dimensional, metallurgical (316L / 304 / Hastelloy), and elastomeric (FDA 21 CFR §177.2600) compliance verified against original manufacturing drawings.
3. **Traceability & Certification**: 3.1 Material Test Certificates (EN 10204 3.1), Certificates of Conformity (CoC), and pressure test records supplied on request.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: What is the entity background and geographical reach of APS?
APS (Process and Automation Systems), online at apsinox.com, is an industrial process engineering and genuine OEM spares distributor based in Ajman / Dubai, United Arab Emirates. APS delivers turnkey skids, machinery lines, and authentic spares throughout the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the broader GCC, MENA, and international markets.

### Q: How does APS guarantee that replacement parts are authentic OEM?
Every spare part is sourced directly through primary manufacturer production channels and authenticated against OEM serial numbers and equipment master records. APS provides material certificates, certificates of origin, and manufacturer warranties.

### Q: What is the RFQ process and turnaround time?
Clients submit part numbers, photos of nameplates, equipment serial numbers, or project tender documents to sales@apsinox.com. The technical engineering desk processes and issues formal quotations within 48 hours.

### Q: Can APS supply complete turn-key plants or only individual components?
APS delivers both: individual critical replacement parts (such as seals, pump rotors, heat exchanger plate packs) as well as custom-engineered process packages including technical design, modular stainless steel skid fabrication, automation programming, and factory acceptance testing (FAT). Delivery scopes are agreed directly with the client.

### Q: How do product recovery systems integrate with CIP operations?
Sanitary product recovery (pigging) systems integrate directly ahead of Clean-in-Place (CIP) cycles. Using projectile food-grade silicone or EPDM pigs propelled by sterile compressed air or CO2, residual product is recovered from process piping with up to 98% efficiency before automated rinsing begins. This prevents product dilution, reduces wastewater BOD loading, and cuts CIP chemical and water consumption by over 60%.
